name: MIPL WP Export – Export Posts, Users, Categories to CSV
author: Mulika Team

sections.description:
MIPL WP Export is a powerful and user-friendly plugin that allows you to export your WordPress data quickly and efficiently.
You can create custom export jobs or use the quick export feature to instantly generate CSV files of your website content.

Export posts, pages, custom post types, users, categories, and taxonomies with ease — all in a clean, structured CSV format that’s compatible with any spreadsheet or import tool.
Perfect for backups, migrations, and analytics, MIPL WP Export makes managing your WordPress data simple, reliable, and secure.

Features

  • Create Export Jobs – Build and save custom export profiles for recurring tasks. Choose exactly what to export and apply filters for precise control.
  • Quick Export – Instantly export selected content with a single click — ideal for quick backups or one-time data extractions.
  • No Limits – Export unlimited records, posts, or downloads without any restrictions. Perfect for large websites or bulk data operations.
  • CSV Export (UTF-8) – Generate clean, UTF-8 encoded CSV files compatible with Excel, Google Sheets, or import tools.
  • Customizable Filters – Export specific data by post type, author, category, taxonomy, status, or date range.
  • Easy-to-Use Interface – Simple, intuitive dashboard designed for users of all skill levels — no coding required.
  • Reusable Export Jobs – Save your settings and run the same export again anytime without reconfiguration.
  • Secure and Reliable – Built with WordPress coding standards for performance and data safety.
  • Fully Compatible – Tested with the latest versions of WordPress and PHP for seamless integration.
  • Fast Performance – Optimized query handling for large databases and high-volume exports.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugins folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
